description: BridgeNet synthetic dataset, published as a single ZIP archive split into numbered binary chunks (GitHub release assets). Concatenating the parts in order (cat part_000 part_001 ... > bridgenet.zip) reconstructs the original archive, whose SHA-256 is given below and in the release asset original.sha256. The archive holds bridgenet/train/<id>/... (5000 domains, ids 00000-04999) and bridgenet/test/<id>/... (500 domains, ids 05000-05499).
